purpose: Work 1: one English story chosen by the second author from six candidates (advice of the makers, fixed on 2026-10-27), one tile per sentence, the whole series under the common height scale and under per-tile min-max. This file is the template: the method was committed before the story was chosen; the inputs marked FILL are written after the choice and committed before the script is run.
fixed_before_running: FILL: date, who chose the story, and that no affect value or lexicon match of the chosen story was computed before this commit

text.source: FILL: Project Gutenberg eBook number and URL of the plain-text file
text.file: FILL: path under external/ (not in the repository)
text.heading: FILL: the heading line of the story, matched exactly after stripping
text.next_heading: FILL: the heading line of the next story, or null for the END marker
text.heading_line: FILL: 1-based line of the heading (counts_final.json, work1, lines[0])
text.sentences: FILL: number of sentences under src/english_text.split_sentences (counts_final.json, work1, sentences)

steps: src/english_text.extract_story (body between the heading and the next heading inside the START and END markers; lines of a paragraph joined by one space; paragraphs wholly in square brackets dropped and listed), src/english_text.split_sentences (decision 1 of .steering/20261028-while-waiting: terminal marks with closing quotation marks, a capital, opening mark or digit next; no cut after Mr Mrs Dr St Messrs Mme Mlle; paragraph ends always cut; pieces without a letter or digit dropped and listed), atact.lexicon.sentence_point (every matched term averaged; a sentence with no matched term is (0, 0) and flagged), atact.mapping.params.

lexicon.name: NRC VAD Lexicon v2.1
lexicon.terms: non-commercial research and education only; not redistributed

relief.decisions: decisions 1 and 2 of .steering/20261028-while-waiting-2: L, D and s_max of the text example of the paper on the rule; base 2.0 mm and e_min 0.4 mm provisional until the printer is known; eps = e_min G* / (2 L) with the G* of that paper (results/k2_gradient.json of the public repository); grid points e_min / 2 apart; STL from H_eps; one seed for every tile

exports.common: z = D H / (2 s_max); top of the solid b + D/2 + z
exports.minmax: z = D (H - min H) / (max H - min H); top b + z
exports.figures: grey common z / D + 1/2 (of H and of H_eps), min-max z / D (of H)

reported: the share of sentences with at least one matched term, as a check of quality; it is not a reason to change the story
not_claimed: Nothing about the emotion of the story: each point is the mean of dictionary values of the matched terms.
